cohort: The cohort includes 25,247 pregnant persons and their 25,911 neonates delivering at the Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital in western Kenya between September 2020 and November 2023.
finding: Nighttime/weekend deliveries were associated with a reduced risk of adverse composite maternal and birth outcomes, but no association was found with neonatal death.
mod_finding: Weekend deliveries were associated with a reduced risk of emergency Caesarean deliveries.
